description: A quiet/settled beat (downtime) — the DM does not nag or force momentum; a short line, open handoff, no menu.

turn.action: I sit by the fire and mend my gear.

response.narration: The fire pops and settles. Your hands find the familiar rhythm of the needle, and for a while the shrine, the ledger, all of it, goes quiet in your head too. It doesn't last, but it's real while it does.
response.dmNotes: settled-pace beat, no forced escalation, no menu
